svg.aria-label: The same operations floor with the approach in place: each action passes a gate that opens only its own key, a freshness stamp and a verifier guard the record, easy tickets take a cheap lane and only hard ones reach the slow planner, a stop button sits within the reviewer's reach, the audit log is filled and the alarm lamp is dark
svg.title: The proposal: scoped keys, checked records, a cheap lane for easy work and a stop button in reach
